title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: gas/flux source and report provide conservative perfect-gas equations and reference coefficients.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads unstructured zones, BC families, TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 and geometry; MIXED section type is rejected.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual and globally reduced diagnostics implemented; laminar gate passes materially changing forces and no independent grid convergence established.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux and frozen Jacobian implemented; report discloses associated diffusion.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths and boundary-state output implemented; accuracy not independently benchmarked.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ reconstruction and continuation implemented; M200 laminar stops at minimum full-order hold with only 1.202 full-order residual orders and changing force.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat/BJ and admissibility fallbacks implemented, with reported phase controls and shock diagnostics.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier wall terms implemented. residual.cpp:323–327,396–425 uses full viscous traction for force columns; separate Cf is tangential, explicitly disclosed by report.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Matrix-free GMRES/LU-SGS with residual gates; original-baseline/phase hold does not ensure laminar force stability.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF full residual and target logic exist. solver.cpp:2533–2545 counts post-target verification passes as nonlinear iterations; stdout records 5 every step and 2757 steps with 3 total linear iterations, but actual padded-pass count and historic source binding are unproven.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halos present; np4/np8 comparison uses different binary hashes, disclosed in report, so rank-only attribution is unproven.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
